title: Benchmark Türkiye public-university dining procurement
acceptance_criteria: Recent public-university food-service procurements are compared using source-traceable IKN, quantity, authority and operating-mode fields
The sample is explicitly labeled purposive/non-exhaustive and never presented as TAM/SAM/SOM
Repeated buyer and explicit-quantity patterns are separated from unvalidated commercial willingness or pain claims
On-site, transported, multi-campus, meal-type, dietary and package-service variation is translated into product architecture implications
A narrower candidate beachhead and cross-institution PMR plan are derived without inventing demand or buyer validation
A machine-readable JSON companion supports downstream IE/CS1/CS2 agents
notes: Secondary public-procurement research only; not PMR or market-size validation.
Sample includes Boğaziçi, Düzce, Abdullah Gül, Türk-Alman, Marmara on-site/transported and İstanbul University notice-level data.
Does not touch KREATE/EVIDENCE.md or KREATE/ASSUMPTIONS.md.
Master promotion remains subject to the CS2 role integration topology and unrelated ancestor CI health.
